item.text:
Bottom line: mixed, but leaning positive on concrete implementation in specific domains. Scholz did turn several 2024 declarations into observable state action, especially on security, digital regulation, budget law, and administrative procedures. The counterweight is real: the coalition collapsed, the year ended in a confidence-loss vote, and some security/governance processes were opaque or defective, which weakens the case for durable follow-through.

### Evidence For
- [Nationale Sicherheitsstrategie vorgestellt](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/nationale-sicherheitsstrategie-2195890) | Bundesregierung | 14 Jun 2023, operative in 2024 | Scholz described the strategy as a “systematic overall approach” spanning diplomacy, police, fire brigades, civil protection, cyber security, and supply-chain resilience, which is concrete whole-of-state implementation architecture rather than slogan-level rhetoric. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Bundeskanzler Scholz bei der Münchner Sicherheitskonferenz](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/scholz-muenchner-konferenz-2261080) | Bundesregierung | 20 Feb 2024 | Scholz said roughly 80% of the Bundeswehr special-fund contracts were already bound and that Germany would station a brigade in Lithuania, showing a declared defense program turning into visible execution. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Bundeskanzler Scholz zum Haushaltsgesetz 2024](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/bundeskanzler-haushalt-2257440) | Bundesregierung | 31 Jan 2024 | Scholz tied the budget to Bürgergeld, Wohngeld, child benefits, and lower social contributions, i.e. promises routed through formal budget channels rather than left as talking points. | 8B.6
- [Agreement on 2025 budget and growth initiative](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116) | Federal Government | 5 Jul 2024 | The coalition agreed a 49-measure package covering modernization, tax relief, infrastructure, social housing, renewables, and support for security objectives. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Summer press conference with Federal Chancellor Scholz](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040) | Federal Government | 24 Jul 2024 | Scholz repeated that the growth initiative would be implemented through 49 concrete measures and linked them to welfare-state stabilization, defense, and Ukraine support, which is observable follow-through. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Bundestag approves changes to the Online Access Act](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw08-de-onlinezugangsgesetz-990686) | Deutscher Bundestag | 23 Feb 2024 | The OZG amendment aimed to lock in Bund-Länder cooperation, central basis services, and modern digital service delivery, showing administrative reach beyond pure rhetoric. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Bundeskabinett – Ergebnisse](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/bundeskabinett-ergebnisse-2263572) | Bundesregierung | 6 Mar 2024 | The cabinet approved procedural reforms for the “executive footprint” and “synopsis,” improving traceability of draft laws and outside influence. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Germany agrees phaseout of Huawei, ZTE components in 5G core network](https://theprint.in/tech/germany-agrees-phaseout-of-huawei-zte-components-in-5g-core-network/2170329/) | Reuters | 11 Jul 2024 | Germany completed contracts to remove critical Chinese components from 5G core networks by end-2026, a concrete regulatory implementation with a fixed timetable. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Joint press release on evaluating Bundeswehr missions abroad](https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/newsroom/news/2664958-2664958) | Federal Foreign Office / Federal Ministry of Defence | 26 Jun 2024 | The government ran its first overarching evaluation of seven missions using uniform criteria and drew specific conclusions on realistic goals and better civilian-military coordination. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Germany to approve EU's planned AI Act](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/germany-will-approve-eus-planned-ai-act--sources-3286730) | Reuters | 30 Jan 2024 | Reuters reported that Germany resolved internal disputes and moved to approve the AI Act, indicating a negotiated regulatory compromise rather than empty digital-policy signaling. | 8B.6

### Evidence Against
- [Germany faces snap election as Scholz's coalition crumbles](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/germanys-awkward-coalition-faces-makeorbreak-moment-3704122) | Reuters | 6 Nov 2024 | Scholz’s firing of Lindner collapsed the coalition and triggered political chaos, which is direct evidence that implementation capacity and governing cohesion weakened sharply. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [394 Abgeordnete sprechen Bundeskanzler Scholz nicht das Vertrauen aus](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198) | Deutscher Bundestag | 16 Dec 2024 | Scholz lost the confidence vote by a wide margin, showing that by year-end his program no longer had stable parliamentary traction. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Germany's Scholz sacks his finance minister, leaving govt's future unclear](https://theprint.in/world/germanys-scholz-sacks-his-finance-minister-leaving-govts-future-unclear/2345270/) | Reuters | 7 Nov 2024 | Reuters described the government as heading into minority-rule uncertainty after the dismissal, which is a concrete hit to follow-through across ministries. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Insider - Regierung entscheidet "in Kürze" über Sicherheit im 5G-Netz](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293) | Reuters via onvista | 23 May 2024 | The 5G decision was handled in confidential interministerial talks with no real-time public comment, which weakens transparency around how the policy was actually made and implemented. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [The Federal Intelligence Service’s powers to conduct strategic surveillance ... are unconstitutional in part](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | The court found parts of the BND surveillance framework unconstitutional and oversight inadequate, a structural weakness in control and accountability systems under Scholz in 2024. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Germany’s defense ministry investigated the leak](https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c) | AP | 4 Mar 2024 | The Taurus recording leak was a real command-and-control failure that forced investigation and procedure tightening, showing that implementation discipline was not uniformly solid. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Geheimes Kanzleramts-Gutachten in Cum-Ex-Affäre](https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/geheimes-kanzleramts-gutachten-in-cum-ex-affare-scholz-darf-weiter-in-deckung-bleiben-11756357.html) | Tagesspiegel | 4 Jun 2024 | The report suggested the Chancellery used a legal memo to blunt Bundestag scrutiny over the Warburg/Cum-Ex affair, which looks more like containment than clean, transparent implementation. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [Bundestag presses government on the 49-measure package](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1034192) | Deutscher Bundestag | 17 Dec 2024 | Parliament was still asking how many of the 49 measures had actually been implemented and what growth effect to expect, indicating the package existed but its traction was still contested. | 8B.6; also 8B.5
- [CDU/CSU criticism of the government’s planning](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1034880) | Deutscher Bundestag | 19 Dec 2024 | CDU/CSU accused the government of “through-put slogans” and ideologically framed planning, which is criticism rather than proof, but it directly challenges the implementation claim. | 8B.6; also 8B.5

### Search Gap
- I found strong evidence on federal security, digital regulation, budget, and administrative-process implementation.
- I found much weaker direct evidence on SPD party discipline, regional implementation depth, and day-to-day delivery inside ordinary ministries and Länder beyond the digital-service and municipal-capacity files.
- The biggest limitation is timing: several good 2024 implementation items were overtaken by late-year coalition collapse and the December no-confidence vote, so durability is materially weaker than early- and mid-2024 execution.
